readOnlyText: This page is read-only. AI Agent can't see this page or your recovery phrase
agentInfoTitle: Need to send, receive or swap?
agentInfoText: These actions run through your AI Agent. This page stays read-only
agentInfoStep1: Open the chat with your AI Agent
agentInfoStep2: Describe what you want to do, for example: send 0.01 BTC. That’s it. AI Agent will do the rest.
footerTagline: The secure crypto wallet for everyday payments. Buy, store and exchange digital assets in seconds.
managerStoppedText: It shuts down after 15 minutes without activity. Ask your AI Agent to open the wallet manager again and use the new link.
walletsNote: New wallets are created here. To use one in the IronWallet app, import it manually
walletsEmpty: No wallets yet. Create a new one or import a recovery phrase you already have.
createNameHint: This name is only visible to you. You can rename the wallet at any time.
createBackupWarning: Back up the recovery phrase right after creating the wallet — it is the only way to restore access.
importPhrasePlaceholder: Enter the words separated by spaces
importNeverShare: Never paste your recovery phrase into an AI Agent or any chat. IronWallet cannot see it either.
renameText: This name is only visible here
deleteQuestion: Are you sure you want to delete it?
deleteWarning: Deleting now is irreversible unless you write down the seed phrase first
deleteConfirmText: You are deleting your wallet forever. You will not be able to recover it without your seed phrase.
deleteAcknowledge: I have my seed phrase saved. I understand that without it I lose access to the funds in this wallet permanently
backupChoose: Choose the wallet to backup manually
backupEmpty: No wallets yet. Create or import one on the Wallets page first.
revealText: Make sure nobody is looking at your screen and that screen recording is off
recoveryText: Write these {n} words down in order and store them offline
recoveryWarning: Never type or paste these words into an AI Agent, a website or a support chat
safetyText: Anyone with your recovery phrase can move your funds. Never share it, never type it into a website or an AI Agent
safetyAccept: I understand and take full responsibility
passphraseText: Write or copy these words in the correct order and keep them in a safe place.
passphraseWarning: Don't share your secret phrase. If someone knows your passphrase, they will have full control over your wallet. Never paste it into an AI Agent.
verifyHint: Click the words to place them in the correct order
verifyAnswerHint: Your words appear here. Click one to take it back.
verifiedText: Your recovery phrase is confirmed. Keep it offline. IronWallet will never ask you for it.
footerNote: Read-only secure view · keys stay on your device
homeInfoTitle: Need to send, buy, sell or swap?
homeInfoText: These actions are available through your AI Agent. This page is read-only
homeBalancesMissing: Balances on {networks} are not available right now and are not included in the total.
homeBalancesLoading: Loading balances on {networks}… They are not in the total yet.
homeNoTokens: No tokens are shown. Use Add tokens to pick some.
homeOnlyZero: All shown tokens have a zero balance. Turn on “Show zero balances” in the sort menu to see them.
tokensBalancesMissing: Balances on {networks} are not available right now.
tokensLimited: Showing {shown} of {total}. Narrow the search to find more.
tokenNotShown: This token is not shown for the wallet. Turn it on in Tokens first.
receiveWarning: Send only {asset} to this address. Sending any other asset may result in permanent loss of tokens.
historyEmpty: No transactions on this network yet.
historyUnavailable: The {network} network is temporarily unavailable. This doesn’t mean your transaction history is empty. Please {retry} in a minute
historyAlternative: Alternatively, you can use {site} to check your balances and history
historyUnsupported: History for {network} is not available in this version. Balances still work.
txSpamWarning: This token looks unsolicited. Do not open links from its name and do not interact with it.
txNotFound: This transaction is not in the loaded history. Go back and open it from the list.
